page</button></div><div class="theme-doc-markdown markdown"><header><h1>EcoTrack</h1></header>
<p>EcoTrack is a shared shipping API that powers a large family of Algerian couriers. Picking the right slug in DZBuild lets you authenticate with a single bearer token and ship through any of these partners:</p>
<p>DHD, Conexlog, MSM Go, Rex Livraison, RB Livraison, Speed Delivery, Areex, Prest, Rocket Delivery, Worldexpress, BaConsult, Packers, 48hr Livraison, MonoHub, Anderson Delivery, Golivri, Coyote Express, Salva Delivery, Distazero, Fretdirect, TSL Express, Negmar Express, Ultra Express, OM Express, MedExpress, Allo Livraison, Assil Delivery, Expedia Chrono, HHD Express, Imir, Navex Delivery, Swift Express, Univer Delivery, Colireli, FZ Delivery, Delivromail, Pdex.</p>
<p>If your courier is on this list, pick its EcoTrack slug — there is no need for a custom integration.</p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Vzrq" id="what-you-need">What you need<a href="#what-you-need" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to What you need" title="Direct link to What you need" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<p>A single value from your courier's EcoTrack-powered dashboard:</p>
<ul>
<li class=""><strong>API token</strong> (sometimes called "Bearer token", "API key" or "clé API").</li>
</ul>
<p>Some EcoTrack-based dashboards split it across two screens (account → API → generate). If you can't find it, ask your account manager to enable API access.</p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Vzrq" id="linking-an-ecotrack-courier-in-dzbuild">Linking an EcoTrack courier in DZBuild<a href="#linking-an-ecotrack-courier-in-dzbuild" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Linking an EcoTrack courier in DZBuild" title="Direct link to Linking an EcoTrack courier in DZBuild" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<ol>
<li class="">Open <strong><code>/dashboard/shipping</code></strong>.</li>
<li class="">Click <strong>Link provider</strong> and pick your specific courier (e.g. <strong>DHD</strong>, <strong>Conexlog</strong>, <strong>MSM Go</strong>, …).</li>
<li class="">Paste your <strong>API token</strong> into the single credential field. EcoTrack-based providers use one field only.</li>
<li class="">Click <strong>Test API</strong>. The dashboard hits the courier live and confirms the token is valid.</li>
<li class="">Save.</li>
</ol>
<p>If your courier is <strong>not</strong> in the dashboard list but is built on EcoTrack, pick <strong>Custom EcoTrack</strong> and provide:</p>
<ul>
<li class="">The <strong>API URL</strong> of your courier's EcoTrack instance (e.g. <code>https://yourcourier.ecotrack.dz</code>).</li>
<li class="">A display name for it.</li>
<li class="">The bearer token.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Vzrq" id="what-gets-synced">What gets synced<a href="#what-gets-synced" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to What gets synced" title="Direct link to What gets synced" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<ul>
<li class="">The list of <strong>wilayas</strong> and <strong>communes</strong> the courier serves.</li>
<li class=""><strong>Home delivery rates</strong> per wilaya.</li>
<li class=""><strong>Stop-desk rates</strong> per wilaya.</li>
<li class="">The <strong>stop-desk list</strong> per wilaya (used by the <a class="" href="/docs/couriers/stop-desk">Stop Desk picker</a>).</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Vzrq" id="what-happens-when-an-order-ships">What happens when an order ships<a href="#what-happens-when-an-order-ships" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to What happens when an order ships" title="Direct link to What happens when an order ships" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<p>When you confirm an order whose store is linked to an EcoTrack courier, DZBuild posts the parcel to the courier's EcoTrack endpoint with:</p>
<ul>
<li class="">Customer name, phone, address.</li>
<li class="">Destination wilaya code + commune.</li>
<li class="">Subtotal as the COD amount.</li>
<li class="">Weight and item summary.</li>
<li class=""><code>delivery_type = home</code> or <code>stopdesk</code>, with a valid <code>stopdesk_id</code> for desk delivery.</li>
</ul>
<p>The courier returns a <strong>tracking number</strong> and (on most EcoTrack instances) a <strong>label/bordereau URL</strong> that you can print and stick on the parcel.</p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Vzrq" id="common-errors-and-fixes">Common errors and fixes<a href="#common-errors-and-fixes" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Common errors and fixes" title="Direct link to Common errors and fixes" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<table><thead><tr><th>Symptom</th><th>Likely cause</th><th>Fix</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Test API returns "unauthorized"</td><td>Wrong or expired token</td><td>Regenerate the token in the courier's dashboard and paste it again.</td></tr><tr><td>"API URL not reachable" (Custom EcoTrack only)</td><td>Wrong domain</td><td>Double-check the URL — most EcoTrack tenants live at <code>https://<name>.ecotrack.dz</code>.</td></tr><tr><td>Order created but no tracking number</td><td>Address rejected by courier</td><td>Inspect the order log; usually a missing or unrecognized commune.</td></tr><tr><td>Stop-desk shipment downgraded to home</td><td>No <code>stopdesk_id</code> selected</td><td>Have the customer pick a desk again, or switch to home delivery.</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Vzrq" id="tips">Tips<a href="#tips" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Tips" title="Direct link to Tips" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<ul>
<li class="">Many EcoTrack-based couriers have <strong>regional</strong> strengths (a specific wilaya cluster). Ask your account manager where they're fastest before promising next-day delivery.</li>
<li class="">If you change couriers but stay inside EcoTrack, you only need to swap the slug + token — orders, addresses and customer data are unaffected.</li>
<li class="">Use <strong>Custom EcoTrack</strong> for new couriers that haven't shown up in the DZBuild dashboard yet; it works as long as the courier exposes the standard EcoTrack endpoints.</li>
</ul></div></article><nav class="docusaurus-mt-lg pagination-nav" aria-label="Docs pages"><a class="pagination-nav__link pagination-nav__link--prev" href="/docs/couriers/yalidine"><div
